title: Endpoint bounds for the lisse coefficient-Hom comparison
statement: Let k, l≠p, m≤n and A=O_E/(ϖ_E^(n+1)), B=O_E/(ϖ_E^(m+1)) with the quotient φ be as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow]. Let S be a separated finite-type k-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], d_S∈N, and a,b,d_X∈Z. Let K,N be bounded constructible complexes of A-modules on S_et [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] with K dualizable of Tor amplitude [0,0] and N of Tor amplitude [a,b+2d_X+1] [def-kun-tor-amplitude], and Q=RHom_A(K,N) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then Q is bounded constructible with Tor amplitude in [a-2d_S,b+2d_X+1+2d_S]; Q⊗^L_A B and RHom_B(K⊗^L_A B, N⊗^L_A B) are bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude over B.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: Widen the interval of N to [min(a,b+2d_X+1), b+2d_X+1]. The finite constructible Hom theorem [cor-weil-finite-constructible-hom] on the separated finite-type S makes Q bounded constructible.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: For dualizable K, RHom(K,N)≅K^∨⊗^L N and K^∨ has Tor amplitude [0,0], so Q has Tor amplitude [a,b+2d_X+1]; since d_S≥0 this interval lies in [a-2d_S,b+2d_X+1+2d_S].

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: The endpoint clause of [lem-coef-finite-hom-domain-calculus], applied to K with [0,0] and N with the widened interval, gives the two reduced endpoints bounded constructible with finite Tor amplitude.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument
